frames.title: Accidental Ideal Outcome Ad Breakdown
frames.on_screen:
ACCIDENTAL IDEAL OUTCOME

WHY THIS AD WORKS
1 #1 - THIS AD AGAIN USES A CLEVER WORD PLAY WITH ONE SIMPLE WORD: "ACCIDENTALLY." THIS CHOICE OF WORDS CREATES CURIOSITY IN THE USER OF "HOW DOES SOMEONE ACCIDENTALLY LOSE THAT MUCH WEIGHT??" OR "MUST BE NICE, HOW DID THEY DO IT??"
2 #2 - THE CALL OUT POINTS AGAIN LEVERAGE INCREDIBLY VISUAL LANGUAGE AROUND "BLOCKING" FAT CELLS FROM FORMING, "DISSOLVING OLD FAT",
3 #3 - THEY LEVERAGE THE LAW OF "UNIQUE NUMBERS" (AT LEAST THAT'S WHAT I CALL IT). NOTICE HOW THEY SAY "12 POUNDS" AND "52" AND "56.4%" AS THOSE NUMBERS ALL HELP TO MAKE THIS AD MORE BELIEVABLE AS THE NUMBERS ARE MORE RANDOM COMPARED TO "10 POUNDS" OR "50" OR "60%"

Ad creative shown:
"I Accidentally Lost 12 Pounds At 52"
Product: ULTIMATE WEIGHT CONTROL
• Blocks fat cells from forming
• Dissolves old, stuck-on fat
• Reduces belly fat by 56.4%
frames.not_in_transcript: Points 2 and 3: visual language ('blocking', 'dissolving'), law of unique numbers ('12 pounds', '52', '56.4%'). Ad bullet points text.
